title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E12 — A Visit From Lena Horne
Fred spots Lena Horne's car in the parking lot while touring the NBC Studios and sneaks away to meet 'the first lady of his dreams.' When there is no answer to the knock on Lena's dressing room door, Fred enters and inspects her personal belongings.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E13 — Sanford & Son & Sister Makes Three
Fred's old flame Juanita brings her daughter Alice to dinner and it's love at first sight for Lamont. Juanita discloses a very delicate and difficult situation when she tells Fred that Alice is really his daughter -- and Lamont is thus dating his sister.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E21 — Every Night Fever
An evening out at the disco turns into 'every night fever' when George stretches a good thing a bit too far. Louise's frustration grows when she realizes that she is to blame.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E22 — Three Faces Of Florence
Florence's efforts to make herself more 'interesting' backfire when her new suitor turns out to be a psychiatrist -- and 'interesting' Florence is one of the worst cases he's seen. George and Louise are worried over Florence's condition.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E23 — Louise's Convention
There's foul play afoot when George tries to duck out of celebrating his wedding anniversary with Louise and she tries to duck out of town to attend a convention.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E24 — The Freeze-In
When a sudden cold spell throws the Jeffersons, the Willises, Florence, and Mr. Bentley into one crowded apartment, the only things heating up are their tempers.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E3 — Once A Friend
George is seeing an old navy buddy, but is it a man or a woman? Louise is suspicious and George is confused.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E4 — George's Help
George jumps at the chance of getting a street kid to work for him at half price, but finds it's costing him more than he bargained for.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E5 — George's Legacy
If Napoleon and Lincoln could do it, so can George Jefferson -- at least that's what George believes.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E6 — Good News, Bad News
An introduction to a friend puts Helen and Louise's friendship on the line -- and George couldn't be happier.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E7 — The Visitors
George and Louise are caught in the line of fire when Florence's battling parents pay the Jefferson household an unexpected and unnerving visit.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E8 — Don Adams, Roscoe Lee Browne, The Staple Singers
Flip is guru Jiva Koolit; Freddie Johnson's girlfriend's away; three guys do jury duty and Rev. Leroy tries off-track betting.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E9 — Tim Conway, Burt Reynolds
Burt & Flip have a western shootout; Tim is the Pink Pirate; all do audience Q&A and Geraldine makes a movie with Burt.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E17 — Shades of Soul! - Part 1
Felipe Luciano hosts this showcase of Latin music on Soul! Features musicians Tito Puente and Willie Colon, accompanied by their musical groups.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E18 — Shades of Soul! - Part 2
Female singing trio LaBelle and conga drum/bongo musician Mongo Santamaria, are guests of Ellis Haizlip.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E22 — Farewell to Arms
Webster asks permission to buy a BB gun and he resorts to responsibility to get one. After getting one, and practicing with his friends, he accidentally kills a bird. This bird has babies and he takes the responsibility of raising them on his own.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E27 — My Family's Honor
Webster and Katherine both end up cheating on some school-related projects at the same time.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E29 — Rear View Mirror (Part 2)
As they continue to reminisce, Webster, Papa Papadapolis, and Jerry receive news that George and Katherine have both survived the hurricane.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E1 — The Landlords
George and Katherine, who bought Bill & Cassie's house, have a three-ring circus with the clown they found to rent the downstairs apartment.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E2 — The Derby
George is so obsessed with Webster winning a derby that he builds the car without him, hurting his feelings since Webster wanted to build the car together.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E11 — Field Trip
A class field trip to a museum lands the twins in detention, while Roger "borrows" a statue that makes him irresistible to women.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E12 — Put to the Test
When Tia and Tamera's SAT scores come in, A-student Tia is stunned to discover that Tamera has pulled a higher score than she has.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E13 — Kid in Play
After Tamera wins the lead in the school play, she transforms from a calm high school student into the ultimate "drama diva," who's driving everyone -- particularly Tia -- crazy.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E14 — Dream Lover
When Tia confides in Tamera that she dreamed of kissing "Stinky Steve," their boss at Rocket Burger, Steve mistakenly believes she's got "the hots" for him.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E15 — Scrambled Eggs
A school project in which Tia and Tamera "marry" Michael and Roger proves to be an eye-opening experience for the twins.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E8 — Birth Control
Moesha gets birth control pills when she decides she would like to lose her virginity to Aaron.  However, things get complicated when Dee finds the pills in her purse.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E5 — A Police Officer And A Gentleman
Eddie is jealous when Nicolette agrees to accompany her commander to a police department dance.
